title: fix(init): the role init frame breaks its own tree gutter
description:
rhachet frames a role init block with a tree gutter that breaks. seen on `rhx init --roles driver` (rhachet 1.49.x).

observed (the init's own tree is intact; the break is in the frame around it):

```
💪 init role repo=bhrain/role=driver
   ├─ $PACKAGE/dist/.../init.claude.status-line.sh
      ├─
      │
      │ 🦉 the path is clear
      │ ...
      └─
   │
   └─ $PACKAGE/dist/.../init.claude.permissions.route.sh
      ├─
      │ ...
      └─
```

defects:
- the first init path is a `├─` branch, but its children are indented with no `│` rail, so the tree reads as detached from its parent
- the init stdout is wrapped in an empty `├─` / `└─` pair, which reads as two empty branches around the content
- a lone `│` joins the two inits, then the second is a `└─` that opens its own empty branch
- the nest depth differs between the two inits: the same block shapes sit one level apart

ask: render each init as one branch, its stdout as indented leaves under it, with a `│` rail on every row until the last branch of the parent closes. no empty `├─` / `└─` rows.

impact: a downstream init that prints a correct tree still reads as broken once framed. downstream snapshots pin the frame as captured, so a fix here moves those snapshots too.

see also: rhachet-roles-bhrain route v2026_10_16.fix-status-line-binds-own-actor, fulcrum F18.
